current.text: Expected to come off the bench, possibly as the first player off it, playing 20 to 25 minutes.
Projected starters ahead of him are Ty Jerome, Cedric Coward, Jerami Grant, Cameron Boozer and Zach Edey.
Memphis is expected to use an 11 or 12 man rotation, and coach Tuomas Iisalo uses short stints and keeps minutes down. This caps bench minutes.
Probably not even a 16-team player. A rank in the 200s is about right.
Memphis has a 4-4-4 schedule in our playoff weeks and only 13 back-to-backs, possibly the fewest in the league.

durable.text: Poor fantasy profile: he adds little in rebounds, assists, steals or blocks, and his shooting percentages are weak.
Makes his threes at only about 35%.
Lacks athleticism and scores inconsistently, but is a sturdy defender.

note: Wells is not a draft target in our league. Yahoo ranks him 179 and ESPN 230, both price him at 0 USD, and the expert says he is not even a 16-team player. Only 144 players get drafted here. His only category above average is turnovers (few of them), and he gives little else on a bench role of 20 to 25 minutes. Early in the season, check whether an injury or a trade (for example Jerami Grant) moves him into the starting lineup. Even then, he would only be a short-term streamer for threes.
